info.headline: Gale Warning issued September 24 at 2:23AM EDT until September 27 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Gray ME
info.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, northeast winds 5 to 15 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and seas 5 to 8 ft expected. For the Gale Warning, northeast winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and seas 8 to 13 ft expected.
* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Stonington, ME to Port Clyde, ME out 25 NM and Coastal Waters from Port Clyde, ME to Cape Elizabeth, ME out 25 NM.
* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, from 2 PM this afternoon to 8 AM EDT Friday. For the Gale Warning, from 2 AM Saturday to 8 PM EDT Sunday.
* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
info.instruction: Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions. Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the vessel for severe conditions.
